title: Existing daily home calendars and received school-mail review

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Retain current local Codex owner and 04:30 Eastern schedule; serialize with separate morning brief before any proposed consolidation.
Verify home and school identities separately; page today and tomorrow completely, including Routine and school commitments.
Read actual received Outlook/Exchange since last verified receipt, bounded to last two business days; Gmail/forwarded messages are partial only.
Do not report overlaps. Identify missing times, school-day markers/duties/classes, preparation deadlines and home commitments.
Distinguish direct requests from forwarded/self-sent summaries; inaccessible session remains an explicit coverage gap.

For consolidation acceptance, establish today actual last-class end from current class evidence, then identify following commitments; unresolved class boundary or calendar coverage must remain explicitly unknown.
For consolidation acceptance, check today IEP coverage/covering-meeting evidence and preserve time/details when found; incomplete sources mean unknown, never none.

Verify calendar account identity independently of display title. A home-owned School Calendar is a home source, not proof of school-account coverage; retain source-labeled disagreements without editing events.

success_checks: One compact daily review includes Eastern times, calendar concerns and few messages needing an answer, with exact available source links.
Coverage describes each separate calendar/mail source and bounded window; no full-inbox claim from partial connectors.
Daily requested review delivered once to existing chat; no reply, event edit or duplicate schedule.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
Consolidation trial output explicitly identifies the verified last-class end and following commitments, or names the unresolved boundary/coverage; a generic after-school list is insufficient.
Consolidation trial output explicitly states IEP coverage/covering-meeting status with sourced time/details or unknown if evidence is incomplete.
Output separates home and school account/calendar coverage and source-labeled disagreements; no automatic event edits or consolidation from an incomplete trial.
